subject: Goblin Boss
picture: A squat goblin boss stands on a wooden chest in a cave hall and points a bent sword. Big pointed ears, long nose, patched armor as large plates, one head, one torso, two arms, two hands, two legs, two feet. Improvised throne of crates behind him. Cave ceiling, closed wooden doors, large floor slabs. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02.
